question: Should OpenClaw permanently support plugin-authored AI-safety events through `safetyDiagnostics.emit()` and retain/query their history in shared core state?
rationale: This choice determines a public plugin SDK contract, manifest permission model, shared-state retention behavior, operator-facing Gateway/CLI/UI surface, and the owner boundary between core diagnostics and optional plugins.

options.title: Narrow the core scope first
options.body: Keep an internal or tightly scoped core diagnostics foundation, correct the emitter documentation, and defer the public plugin emission API and broad operator surface until owners define their contract.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Accept the plugin API, manifest permission, durable history, and operator query surfaces as permanent supported OpenClaw contracts with named ownership and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the entire cross-surface feature until the diagnostics and plugin-SDK owners agree on product scope and retention policy.

recommendation.title: Narrow the core scope first
recommendation.body: Keep an internal or tightly scoped core diagnostics foundation, correct the emitter documentation, and defer the public plugin emission API and broad operator surface until owners define their contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The active PR discussion directly asks this person for the API and product-direction decision.
